bigIdeas.en: Numbers to 20 represent quantities that can be decomposed into 10s and 1s.
bigIdeas.zh: 20 以内的数表示数量，可以拆成几个十和几个一。

bigIdeas.en: Addition and subtraction with numbers to 10 can be modelled concretely, pictorially, and symbolically to develop computational fluency.
bigIdeas.zh: 10 以内的加减法可以用实物、图画和算式来表示，慢慢练到熟练。

bigIdeas.en: Repeating elements in patterns can be identified.
bigIdeas.zh: 规律里重复出现的那一组，是可以找出来的。

bigIdeas.en: Objects and shapes have attributes that can be described, measured, and compared.
bigIdeas.zh: 物体和图形有各自的特征，可以描述、测量和比较。

bigIdeas.en: Concrete graphs help us to compare and interpret data and show one-to-one correspondence.
bigIdeas.zh: 实物统计图帮我们比较和读懂数据，一个对一个地数清楚。

elaborations.en: counting: counting on and counting back; skip-counting by 2 and 5; sequencing numbers to 20; comparing and ordering numbers to 20; Numbers to 20 can be arranged and recognized.; subitizing; base 10; 10 and some more
elaborations.zh: 数数：接着往后数、倒着数；2 个 2 个、5 个 5 个地跳着数；给 20 以内的数排顺序；比较和排序 20 以内的数；20 以内的数可以摆一摆、认一认；一眼看出有几个（subitizing）；十进制；「十和几」

elaborations.en: books published by Native Northwest: Learn to Count, by various artists; Counting Wild Bears, by Gryn White; We All Count, by Jason Adair; We All Count, by Julie Flett (nativenorthwest.com) using counting collections made of local materials; counting in different languages; different First Peoples counting systems (e.g., Tsimshian)
elaborations.zh: Native Northwest 出版的数数绘本（Learn to Count、Counting Wild Bears、We All Count 等）；用本地材料做的数数收藏；用不同语言数数；原住民（First Peoples）不同的计数系统（如 Tsimshian）

elaborations.en: Tlingit Math Book (yukon-ed-show-me-your-math.wikispaces.com/file/detail/Tlingit Math Book.pdf)
elaborations.zh: Tlingit 数学书（Tlingit Math Book）

elaborations.en: decomposing 10 into parts
elaborations.zh: 把 10 拆成几部分

elaborations.en: Numbers to 10 can be arranged and recognized.
elaborations.zh: 10 以内的数可以摆一摆、认一认。

elaborations.en: benchmarks of 10 and 20
elaborations.zh: 以 10 和 20 为基准点

elaborations.en: Traditional First Peoples counting methods involved using fingers to count to 5 and for groups of 5.
elaborations.zh: 原住民传统的数数方法：用手指数到 5，5 个 5 个地数。

elaborations.en: traditional songs/singing and stories
elaborations.zh: 传统歌谣和故事

items.en: addition and subtraction to 20 (understanding of operation and process)
items.zh: 20 以内的加减法（理解运算的意思和过程）

elaborations.en: decomposing 20 into parts
elaborations.zh: 把 20 拆成几部分

elaborations.en: mental math strategies: counting on; making 10; doubles
elaborations.zh: 心算策略：接着数；凑十；双倍（doubles）

elaborations.en: Addition and subtraction are related.
elaborations.zh: 加法和减法是有关系的。

elaborations.en: whole-class number talks
elaborations.zh: 全班一起聊数（number talks）

elaborations.en: nature scavenger hunt in Kaska Counting Book (yukon-ed-show-me-your-math.wikispaces.com/file/detail/Kaska Counting Book.pdf)
elaborations.zh: Kaska Counting Book 里的大自然寻宝

items.en: repeating patterns with multiple elements and attributes
items.zh: 重复的规律（多个元素、多种特征）

elaborations.en: identifying sorting rules
elaborations.zh: 说出分类的规则

elaborations.en: repeating patterns with multiple elements/attributes
elaborations.zh: 有多个元素 / 多种特征的重复规律

elaborations.en: translating patterns from one representation to another (e.g., an orange-blue pattern could be translated to a circle-square pattern)
elaborations.zh: 把规律从一种表示换成另一种（如橙—蓝的规律换成圆—方的规律）

elaborations.en: letter coding of pattern
elaborations.zh: 用字母给规律编码（如 ABB）

elaborations.en: predicting an element in repeating patterns using a variety of strategies
elaborations.zh: 用各种办法预测重复规律里的某一个

elaborations.en: patterns using visuals (ten-frames, hundred charts)
elaborations.zh: 用图来看规律（十格框、百数表）

elaborations.en: investigating numerical patterns (e.g., skip-counting by 2s or 5s on a hundred chart)
elaborations.zh: 探究数的规律（如在百数表上 2 个 2 个、5 个 5 个地跳着数）

elaborations.en: beading using 3–5 colours
elaborations.zh: 用 3–5 种颜色串珠

items.en: change in quantity to 20, concretely and verbally
items.zh: 20 以内数量的变化（用实物和语言）

elaborations.en: verbally describing a change in quantity (e.g., I can build 7 and make it 10 by adding 3)
elaborations.zh: 用语言说出数量的变化（如「我摆了 7 个，再加 3 个就变成 10 个」）

elaborations.en: demonstrating and explaining the meaning of equality and inequality
elaborations.zh: 演示并解释相等和不相等的意思

elaborations.en: recording equations symbolically, using = and ≠
elaborations.zh: 用 = 和 ≠ 把式子记下来

items.en: direct measurement with non-standard units (non-uniform and uniform)
items.zh: 用非标准单位直接测量（大小不一的和大小一样的）

elaborations.en: Non-uniform units are not consistent in size (e.g., children’s hands, pencils); uniform units are consistent in size (e.g., interlocking cubes, standard paper clips).
elaborations.zh: 大小不一的单位不一样长（如小朋友的手、铅笔）；大小一样的单位一样长（如拼接方块、标准回形针）。

elaborations.en: understanding the importance of using a baseline for direct comparison in linear measurement
elaborations.zh: 量长度时要对齐同一条起始线，才能直接比较

elaborations.en: using multiple copies of a unit
elaborations.zh: 用好几个同样的单位接着摆

elaborations.en: iterating a single unit for measuring (e.g., to measure the length of a string with only one cube, a student iterates the cube over and over, keeping track of how many cubes long the string is)
elaborations.zh: 只用一个单位反复接着量（如只有一个方块时，一次次挪着量绳子，数出绳子有几个方块长）

elaborations.en: tiling an area
elaborations.zh: 铺满一块面积

elaborations.en: rope knots at intervals
elaborations.zh: 每隔一段打一个结的绳子

elaborations.en: using body parts to measure
elaborations.zh: 用身体部位来量

elaborations.en: book: An Anishnaabe Look at Measurement, by Rhonda Hopkins and Robin King-Stonefish (strongnations.com/store/item_display.php?i=3494&f=)
elaborations.zh: 绘本：An Anishnaabe Look at Measurement

elaborations.en: hand/foot tracing for mitten/moccasin making
elaborations.zh: 描手 / 描脚的轮廓来做手套 / 软皮鞋

items.zh: 平面图形和立体图形的比较

elaborations.en: sorting 3D objects and 2D shapes using one attribute, and explaining the sorting rule
elaborations.zh: 按一个特征给立体和平面图形分类，并说出分类规则

elaborations.en: comparing 2D shapes and 3D objects in the environment
elaborations.zh: 比较身边的平面图形和立体图形

elaborations.en: describing relative positions, using positional language (e.g., up and down, in and out)
elaborations.zh: 用方位词描述相对位置（如上和下、里和外）

elaborations.en: replicating composite 2D shapes and 3D objects (e.g., putting two triangles together to make a square)
elaborations.zh: 照样子拼出组合的平面图形和立体图形（如两个三角形拼成一个正方形）

items.zh: 实物统计图（一个对一个）

elaborations.en: creating, describing, and comparing concrete graphs
elaborations.zh: 制作、描述和比较实物统计图

items.en: likelihood of familiar life events, using comparative language
items.zh: 生活里的事有多可能发生（用比较的说法）

elaborations.en: using the language of probability (e.g., never, sometimes, always, more likely, less likely)
elaborations.zh: 用可能性的说法（如 从不、有时、总是、更可能、更不可能）

elaborations.en: cycles (Elder or knowledge keeper to speak about ceremonies and life events)
elaborations.zh: 周期循环（请长者或知识传承人讲仪式和人生大事）

items.en: financial literacy — values of coins, and monetary exchanges
items.zh: 认识钱：硬币的面值和用钱交换

elaborations.en: identifying values of coins (nickels, dimes, quarters, loonies, and toonies)
elaborations.zh: 认识硬币的面值（5 分 nickel、10 分 dime、25 分 quarter、1 元 loonie、2 元 toonie）

elaborations.en: counting multiples of the same denomination (nickels, dimes, loonies, and toonies)
elaborations.zh: 数同一种硬币有多少钱（nickel、dime、loonie、toonie）

elaborations.en: Money is a medium of exchange.
elaborations.zh: 钱是用来交换东西的。

elaborations.en: role-playing financial transactions (e.g., using coins and whole numbers), integrating the concept of wants and needs
elaborations.zh: 角色扮演买卖（用硬币和整数），并结合「想要」和「需要」

elaborations.en: trade games, with understanding that objects have variable value or worth (shells, beads, furs, tools)
elaborations.zh: 以物易物的游戏：懂得东西各有不同的价值（贝壳、珠子、毛皮、工具）
